name: InterContinental Costa Rica at Multiplaza Mall
insider_take: This sleek urban oasis sits atop Central America's most luxurious shopping destination, offering unparalleled convenience in Costa Rica's Beverly Hills.
whats_special: The InterContinental Costa Rica is uniquely positioned directly above Multiplaza Mall, making it the only luxury hotel in Central America with direct indoor access to premium shopping, dining, and entertainment. Escazú is known as the country's financial district and expat haven, featuring the highest concentration of multinational corporations and diplomatic residences in Costa Rica.
pro_tip: Take advantage of the hotel's direct mall access for last-minute souvenir shopping or late-night dining without stepping outside – perfect during Costa Rica's rainy season (September-November).
dont_miss: The stunning panoramic views of the Central Valley and surrounding volcanic mountains from the upper floors, plus easy access to Escazú's famous weekend farmers market featuring exotic tropical fruits and artisanal crafts just minutes from the hotel.
pros: Direct access to premier Multiplaza Mall for luxury shopping and dining
Prime location in upscale Escazu district with easy city access
Modern business hotel amenities and professional service standards
Convenient base for both business travelers and Costa Rica exploration
cons: Urban mall setting lacks traditional Costa Rican atmosphere
Limited outdoor recreational facilities compared to resort properties
